Evanescent basis: the bosonic d-dimensional poles of AA (-(5/3 C - 1/3 S_H)) and AAA (-(2/3 C - 1/3 S_H)) equal -a(Q_T+Q_3f)^d - b(2Q_T+3Q_3f)^d with a = 11/3 C - 1/3 S_H, b = -C. tilde(E)_F alone (ratio 1:1) cannot carry both evanescent parts; a second evanescent direction (evanescent part of the d-dimensional field-counting operator of A, ratio 2:3 plus ghost-source terms) is missing from eq:evanescent of 03b, or the bosonic counterterm must be stated in d-dimensional form. Here the AAA part is stated as -B tilde(E)_F|_AAA, consistent with g0_VV's -(5/3 C - 1/3 S_H) tilde(E)_F|_AA only as separate monomial coefficients.
